files.README.md:
# boiler house journal

Netherby Laundry's boiler house runs the burner that heats the wash water.
Every cycle writes one line to logs/boiler.log:

    <UTC time> CYCLE burner=<id> load=<n> minutes=<n> fuel=<n>

`load` is the number of garments the cycle took in, `minutes` is how long the
cycle ran and `fuel` is the gas units the burner drew. A session ends with a
summary line carrying the number of cycles it ran and the gas units it drew in
total, and the journal is replaced when the next session starts.
